verdict.rationale: Canny's own MCP feature documents that a PM can "reply to customers" while moving ideas through the workflow, and the changelog lets teams "show customers you heard them" to close the loop. However, the reply capability is only described as an action taken from inside an external LLM, not from within the feedback record in Canny itself, and there are no details on how replies work. missing for 10: documented in-record reply UI on the feedback post, details of reply delivery (email/comment/notification), first-party docs depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop

citations.quote: Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
